description.value: A 24/7 McDonald's franchise on Kingsway in Vancouver, offering the full Canadian McDonald's menu including breakfast, burgers, McCafé beverages, and seasonal limited-time items. The location includes a drive-through and indoor seating, making it a convenient all-weather stop for cyclists passing through the Kingsway corridor. Wheelchair accessible.
